request.summary: Refine the separately identified Donor Directory Wallboard custom app into a polished reference-led touch kiosk with three generic donor display-field mappings, TABLE-type-aware currency prefixes, optional category descriptions, a complete balanced portrait category directory, an on-demand dismissible search keyboard, adaptive high-density rows with an optional sparse-page height cap, and comprehensive editor-controlled typography, background media, overlay, and color theming.
request.audience: Visitors browsing or searching a shared donor-recognition kiosk, and Wallboard editors configuring data mappings, behavior, and institutional branding.
request.primaryGoal: Let a visitor quickly find or browse donors by category in a professional, distinctive interface while editors can map any three table columns, safely tune density up to twenty entries per column, and brand every important visual role.

assumptions: The active donor TABLE has been renamed Donor Information and its representative maintained columns are Name, Category, and Amount; live identifiers and customer records are not retained in source artifacts.

Entry Field 1 is the required identity and search field; Entry Fields 2 and 3 are optional and render any safely displayable scalar, structured date, or file-name value without amount-specific semantics.
Legacy name, amount, and extra-text settings remain mapper-only fallbacks so existing placements can migrate without changing the Donor Directory app identity.
ALL, page 1, empty query, and autoplay off are the initial state on every mount.
The optional category metadata TABLE is the scalable authoring model for category order, label, and explanatory range; without it categories sort alphabetically and show no description.
Category descriptions render persistently for the active category because a hover-only tooltip is not discoverable on a touch kiosk.
Editors may also show metadata descriptions beneath category-button labels; button-description and active-heading-description typography and colors remain independent.
Currency-style grouping is opt-in and applies only when the mapped TABLE header declares the field type as number; headerless row arrays and numeric-looking text remain raw.
Search uses Entry Field 1, is case- and diacritic-insensitive, and ranks prefix matches before substring matches with configured datasource sort as the tie-breaker.
Search remains in a stable ALL context and shows a category badge on each result instead of changing the active category as the best match changes.

The editor-selected directory column count is a maximum: landscape supports up to four donor columns, portrait up to three, and square up to two. Portrait does not infer a lower cap from a scaled editor-host width.

Portrait shows every category at once in balanced wrapped rows with equal track widths, row-aligned heights, complete text, and a centered incomplete final row; it never relies on hidden horizontal overflow.

Entries per column is honored from one through twenty; row height, padding, and all three field sizes scale from the configured maxima and available directory height. Maximum row height defaults to zero/automatic and, when positive, caps sparse-page growth without forcing full-page rows taller.

A placement-level background image can override the packaged Light/Custom background or solid Dark fallback in any selected color scheme; an independent overlay color and zero-to-one-hundred opacity sit above that image and below the directory shell.

The touch keyboard is enabled by an editor setting but opens only when the search field or keyboard icon is activated and can be explicitly dismissed. Its preserved bottom-row geometry presents CLEAR, BACKSPACE, SPACE, and accent SEARCH in that order; SEARCH closes the keyboard without clearing the live query, and toggling the keyboard icon closed removes both search and icon active highlighting.
Autoplay excludes ALL to avoid replaying the complete donor set before category pages; the enable action may override seconds per page and the editor duration is its fallback.
An intentional visitor input stops autoplay and the same control remains active, so the first touch is never discarded.
Donor detail pages, datasource writes, analytics, fuzzy search, donor photos, and inactivity-based autoplay restart are outside version 1.

surfaceStrategy.rationale: The request explicitly requires responsive portrait and landscape kiosk placements and does not constrain the app to one fixed canvas.

ownership.rationale: Donor records remain durable in the existing internal TABLE and update without rebuilding the app.
Optional category order, labels, and descriptions have independent shared ownership and authoring cadence.
Editors map customer-specific field names and decide which optional donor values are presented.
Editors own institutional copy, header media, density, time display, keyboard visibility, and autoplay fallback behavior.
Coordinated presets provide safe defaults while Custom exposes every important semantic color plus independent display, interface, category, and donor-field typography.
Browse and search state is private to the active kiosk session and resets on mount.
Wallboard actions own start, stop, and full reset transitions plus the optional runtime duration override; the timer remains instance-local.
Deterministic joins, stable search context, sequence rules, and safe complex-cell handling prevent placement-specific ambiguity.

views.purpose: Browse category pages and inspect up to three editor-mapped values per donor entry.
Search all donors with stable category context and result badges.
Enter a donor query through an on-demand touch keyboard overlay.
Present real category pages unattended after a Wallboard action.

inputs.action: Select categories, change pages, open or dismiss the on-screen keyboard, type a query, and clear search.
Type into the same controlled donor search and use standard editing keys.
Enable pagination with an optional duration override, disable it, or reset the entire experience to ALL/page 1 with empty search and a closed keyboard.

session.expectation: Mount starts at ALL/page 1 with an empty query and autoplay off; purposeful touch exits autoplay while preserving the touched action.

rendering.rationale: The framed directory shell uses a left category directory in landscape, a complete wrapped category directory in portrait, and a compact horizontal rail in square placements. Search, donor rows, controls, and the donor-table-scoped keyboard recompose by measured container ratio while filling the assigned kiosk surface.

motion.rationale: A short bounded fade communicates page/category changes; Off updates immediately and never stops timed progression.

media.fallback: Use the coordinated solid mint background color.
media.rationale: A restrained generated mint curve-and-dot texture carries the supplied reference's depth without copying its brand or marketing interface.

media.fallback: Use the packaged reference background for Light and Custom, and the coordinated solid background for Dark.
media.rationale: Editors may replace the canvas image in any color scheme while retaining the selected scheme's coordinated semantic palette.

media.fallback: Remove the logo region and preserve header balance without showing a broken-image marker.
media.rationale: Each institution selects its own Wallboard-managed logo without embedding customer media in the app.

branding.fallback: Use the coordinated mint, off-white, forest, black, and spring-green Light theme, with matching Dark and fully semantic Custom alternatives.

states.expectation: The complete reference-led light-theme landscape directory shows ALL, page 1, the default Name and Amount values with support for a third field, a left category directory, full-width search, and a closed keyboard.
The full touch journey remains readable and contained at 1280x720.
The framed shell, wrapped categories, three donor columns, and search remain balanced at 1080x1920 while the on-demand keyboard stays reachable.

Nine real categories plus ALL remain simultaneously visible in balanced equal-width portrait rows; buttons stretch within each row, all copy remains complete, and the incomplete final row is centered without horizontal scrolling.
The square composition keeps balanced header, categories, search, donor rows, and controls with the keyboard closed.
The coordinated dark palette preserves the reference-led hierarchy, fine borders, and touch states while remaining compatible with an editor-selected background image and overlay.
Every semantic Custom color plus the placement-level background image and overlay apply coherently without fixed light-theme remnants.
An unbound primary datasource shows clear editor binding guidance and no synthetic donor fallback.
A bound empty table shows the configured empty-state message in a stable composition.
A missing configured table or required Entry Field 1/category mapping shows a quiet actionable configuration state.
Derived categories sort alphabetically and no category description appears.
Metadata numeric/source order, public labels, and active description control the category presentation.
Three arbitrary mapped fields render with independent hierarchy, font controls, and colors without amount-specific behavior.
Mapped fields declared number by the TABLE header receive locale grouping and the configured literal prefix while text fields remain raw.
A single mapped donor field uses the full card width, vertically centers, and auto-fits its complete long value without truncation.

Activating search opens an uppercase bottom keyboard over only the donor table while the landscape category directory, header, and search stay visible; its preserved bottom row reads CLEAR, BACKSPACE, SPACE, SEARCH.
Typing switches to stable ALL/search context, filters donors, shows category badges, and highlights the best match.
A nonmatching query shows the configured no-results message and remains easy to clear.
Twenty entries per column are present, contained, and legible with reduced row padding and density-aware field sizes.
Long title, Entry Field 1 values, categories, descriptions, optional fields, and localized metadata remain readable without clipped ink.
A high representative donor/category count remains paged with bounded DOM; landscape category overflow remains usable while portrait uses the complete wrapped directory.
The final partial page retains directory-row rhythm and correct disabled navigation.
A configured maximum donor-row height prevents a one-entry final page from inflating while leaving automatic full-page sizing and pagination intact.
An absent/broken logo removes its region without a broken-image marker or header imbalance.
A processed donor row array renders the same directory as the native TABLE wrapper.
A live donor update preserves valid category/page state, clamps removed pages, and updates search results.
A category metadata update changes order/description without resetting a still-valid manual selection.

behaviors.expectation: Native Donor Information TABLE, selected table, row array, renamed three-field mappings, and safe complex display values normalize deterministically without recursive wrapper search.
Currency formatting is opt-in, applies to any of the three mapped TABLE number fields, honors locale and literal prefix, and never infers types for text columns or headerless row arrays.
ALL is first in manual mode; optional metadata uses numeric or source order and unmatched real categories append alphabetically.
Category-button descriptions are optional and use typography and color controls independent from the active category description above donor rows.

Portrait renders every category in non-scrolling equal-width flex tracks, stretches ALL to the height of its row peers, centers an incomplete final row, preserves complete copy, and keeps all buttons inside the visible navigation region.
Category selection resets to page 1 and arrows/page indicator remain correct through one-page and uneven-last-page states.

Search focus or the keyboard icon opens the app-owned uppercase keyboard over only the donor table; lowercase input payloads become a title-cased query in stable ALL context; CLEAR resets the query while staying open; and SEARCH, the icon, or an outside touch dismisses it without clearing the current query or showing a dimming overlay. Toggling the icon closed also removes the icon and search active highlighting.
Zero maximum row height preserves automatic equal-height sizing, while a positive cap limits sparse-page donor rows without changing page capacity, full-page shrink behavior, or navigation.
Light and Custom fall back to the packaged background, Dark falls back to its solid canvas, and an editor-selected background image plus overlay color/opacity applies in every preset.
resetExperience stops autoplay, clears and blurs search, closes the keyboard, selects ALL, restores page 1, and resets autoplay frame and fallback duration.
Entries-per-column values from one through twenty are honored, all mapped fields remain vertically centered, and per-value auto-fit reduces typography without truncation.
The native search input accepts physical typing and editing while sharing the same normalization and filtering state.
enablePaginationMode applies a validated duration override, visits every real-category page in order, and loops or stops at the configured final frame.
disablePaginationMode restores initial manual state; a purposeful touch stops autoplay and still performs the touched action.
Autoplay continues with motion Off and repeated enable commands never create more than one timer.
Independent donor/category updates preserve stable keys when valid and reset or clamp deterministically when content disappears.
All clock/autoplay timers, resize observers, command subscriptions, and input listeners are instance-local and released on destroy.

visualDirection.summary: Translate the supplied reference's premium editorial SaaS language into a donor-recognition kiosk: pale mint field, crisp off-white shell, deep forest framing, black editorial display type, clean sans UI, spring-green selection, thin borders, restrained shadow, and generous negative space.
signatureChoices: A single elevated off-white directory shell sits over a quiet packaged mint curve-and-dot backdrop, echoing the reference's depth without copying its branding or interface.
The header directly adapts the reference's horizontal navigation logic: institution logo left, editorial directory title centered, date and time right, with a slim deep-forest gratitude strip.

Categories become a left directory in landscape, a balanced complete multi-row button directory in portrait, and a compact touch-scrollable rail in square placements; donor content reads as a premium directory sheet with fine row rules rather than repeated dashboard cards.
Three independently styled donor fields change from spacious stacked hierarchy to a compact aligned row as the editor raises entries per column.
avoid: Document Viewer or PDF-reader identity and layout
Generic vibe-coded dashboard cards, beige honor-wall clichés, or unrelated landing-page sections
Copied Vectra logos, text, product screenshots, or marketing content
CSS-drawn decorative motifs, glossy gradients, glass effects, or emoji/text-glyph icons
An always-visible keyboard that consumes donor-directory space

visualReview.intent: A credible, highly brandable donor-recognition kiosk where visitors can immediately understand the active tier, scan names, search confidently, and use every touch control in portrait or landscape.
focus: Verify donor names remain the visual priority and complete glyph ink is preserved at every adaptive surface.

Verify the landscape category directory, complete non-scrolling portrait button rows, or compact square rail, active description, larger page controls, and donor-table-scoped keyboard remain reachable without crowding one another.
Verify Light, Dark, and Custom palettes cover every semantic surface and selected/disabled state, and that an editor-selected background image plus overlay remain behind the directory shell.

Verify long categories, descriptions, donor names, localized date/time, maximum counts, odd/even portrait button rows, and partial pages use deliberate space rather than clipping, hidden categories, tiny text, or inflated sparse-page rows.
Verify the interface does not resemble the Document Viewer or an unrelated boilerplate example.
